sources.risk_domain: Fresh p_selected/R/p_max/p_other_max are NaN outside phi>d_min, separated, finite represented features; use prefix_probability_valid.
sources.frozen_domain: frozenpost_valid uses the nominal separated MF domain; affine feature distances may become negative at the saved postsolve state.

units.sf_native_margin_mm: millimetres; paired SF gamma/floor/cap on BOTH controllers' trajectories
units.sf_quantile: (phi-d_min)/sigma_selected - gamma; dimensionless, UNCLIPPED, not equivalent to native capped SF feasibility when cap/floor active
units.mf_quantile: implemented inverse-CDF with linear extension for R>.5 and lower-tail clipping
units.native_affine: m for SF; standard-normal quantile for MF

masks.nominal_valid: successful normal solve with finite reconstructed pre-solve nominal
masks.replay_valid: native replay validation, including MF activation-mask consistency
masks.frozenpost_valid: nominal model probability comparison is valid

sources.selector_id: canonical branch identity with endpoint aliases merged; a change alone does not establish discontinuity
sources.other_feature: Exclude nominal selected-equivalent d/full-q events (tolerances1e-7m/1e-6); other slots are not mutually deduplicated.
sources.probability: Affine Gaussian marginal probabilities and raw Boole sum with duplicates/correlation; R can exceed1 and is not empirical or exact collision probability.
sources.native_affine: Before MF lower slack. Source helper native residual arrays preserve its original semantics; use explicit masks.
sources.SF_affine_pass_fresh_guard_fail: SF affine >= -1um while fresh phi-d_col < -1um; can also be evaluated as a shadow SF row on MF states.
